OpenScarlett notice

Palmwave's Xbox Series device resource routes (device slots 92-95, 108-110 and 112 in
runtime/shims/d3d12_xs_device.cpp) take their slot-to-method mapping from OpenScarlett,
src/shims/d3d12_xs_shim.cpp, revision 87cdba6a16052a5809f904ed5725d70e50521744
(2026-11-23T21:38:41Z), by OpenScarlett Contributors. Only that mapping, and the idea of
accepting both struct-return call forms at slots 95/108, is used. OpenScarlett's method bodies
(description conversion, session dropping, state retries, flag masking and fallback resources)
are not used. Its license follows unchanged.
